messages:
elena: Follow-up from today's all-hands about the reorg and headcount plan. Posting quick answers to the common questions.

sam: Is there a hiring freeze or selective hires only?

elena: No freeze. We're prioritizing infra, serving, and reliability roles. Other reqs will be reviewed case-by-case.

morgan: Will managers be notified before public announcements?

elena: Yes, managers with direct changes get a manager brief 24-48h before team notes. HR will provide a short template.

arjun: Any changes to promotion timelines because of org alignment?

people-ops: Promotion cadence unchanged. Leveling alignment will be done during the next calibration window; raise edge cases to People Ops.

recruiting-bot: Hiring tracker published: https://recruiting.redwood.ai/q2 (updated) :mag:

morgan: How will oncall be handled during the merge?

elena: Eng-sre + transition roster will own oncall for first 6 weeks; we'll post overlaps and temporary schedules.

elena: We'll publish an FAQ and a one-pager for PMs by EOD. DM me if you need anything else.
